outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative super-resolution micrograph reconstructions (2D projection, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) for CtpG-mEos; it is not a quantification plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B shows representative super-resolution micrograph reconstructions for PacL2-mEos, analogous to panel A; not a plot of averaged data.
Number of clusters/cell is shown as a scatter/dot plot with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cell, as stated in the caption ('represented by gray dots').
Cluster size is shown as a scatter/dot plot with individual gray dots representing individual clusters, with mean ± SEM overlaid, per the caption.
Percentage of molecules in clusters is shown as a scatter/dot plot with individual gray dots representing individual cells, with mean ± SEM overlaid, per the caption.
Panel F shows representative sptPALM micrographs (2D projection and trajectory overlays); it is not an averaged quantification plot.
This is a histogram of diffusion coefficients pooled from 19 cells; it displays a distribution of raw values rather than an average with error bars, so overlaying individual points is not applicable.

This is a line plot showing MSD curves for individual molecule trajectories; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement, and here each line already represents an individual trajectory.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph, which are visual/spatial representations of tracking data rather than a plot of averaged summary statistics.
